$description: Jahnoah.com — consulting, executive retainment, writeups, portfolio. Tone: editorial authority, unhurried. A serif for presence, generous white space, restrained accent. This is the LEAST templated of the three — no mono, no citrus. Deliberately reads as a person, not a product.

accent.$description: brick/oxide — a printed-page red, not a SaaS accent. Used only for the one link/CTA color and small marks.

gold.$description: reserved for 'paid content' badges only — the one place a second accent is allowed

border.$description: hairline, not the near-black border OnlyJah uses — softer, editorial

display.$description: the one bold move on this site — a high-contrast serif at large size

body.$description: serif body, slightly larger line-height than sans (per typography guidance)

meta.$description: dates, tags, nav only — never headlines
